verdict.rationale: Mastra documents its own workflow engine for composing typed steps, retries, and branches. A community comment shows graph-style chaining (.step().then().after()), which hints at join points but does not document them. Nothing in the evidence covers parallel step execution, fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches, or nested child workflows, and one user found branching workflows clunky enough to replace them with custom code. Missing for 10: documented parallel steps, dynamic-batch fan-out/fan-in (foreach-style), child/nested workflow composition, and hands-on corroboration of these patterns.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I compose workflows from parallel steps, fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches, and child workflows without hand-rolling coordination

citations.quote: Compose typed steps, retries, and branches into production workflows your team can inspect and ship.
